description: End one hire on your bounty using its `escrowId`, including a hire funded with wallet money from the bounty’s pool. The rest of the bounty keeps running. A pool seat paid by card can’t be ended this way; the error says how to release it. If you would get back less than the full amount, the first call ends nothing and returns `status: confirmation_required`, `confirmationToken`, `expiresAt`, `totalRefundAmount` (cents) and `currency`. Show the user `totalRefundAmount`. If they agree, call again with the same `escrowId` and the `confirmationToken` before `expiresAt`. The reply returns `status: cancelled`, `totalRefundAmount` (cents) and `currency`. Repeating the confirmation is safe and pays once; if a reply has `status: processing`, call again the same way to finish. If an error says “Request cancellation again”, call again without the token and show the new refund. A full refund ends the hire on the first call, with no preview. To cancel the whole bounty, use `cancel_bounty`. Use `open_dispute` for problems with the work.

confirmationToken.description: The `confirmationToken` returned with `status: confirmation_required`. Send it after the user approves the refund and before `expiresAt` to end the hire.
confirmationToken.title: minLength(1)

details.description: Private explanation, required with `reason: "other"` and accepted only with that reason; include at least one non-whitespace character, up to 500 characters.
details.title: maxLength(500)

escrowId.description: The `escrowId` of the hire to end, from `accept_application` or `list_escrows`.
escrowId.title: minLength(1)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key, up to 200 characters, for retrying the same first call. The confirmation call does not need it.
idempotencyKey.title: maxLength(200)

reason.description: Optional reason for ending the hire; defaults to `task_requirements_changed`. Choose `worker_unresponsive`, `worker_not_fit`, `scheduling_availability`, `worker_requested_cancellation`, `task_requirements_changed` or `other`; `work_not_completed` is accepted by the input schema but the cancellation policy returns a refusal directing you to open a dispute.

name: cancel_hire
title: Cancel hire
